quest.title: The Sight of the Divine Emissary
quest.description: The voting results for Ayaka's outfit will soon be revealed...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Check out the results of the vote

dialogues.speaker: Voting Results for the Emissary's Outfit
dialogues.text: Voting results for "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?"...

dialogues.speaker: Voting Results for the Emissary's Outfit
dialogues.text: Voting results for "The Case Files of Miss Orith"...

dialogues.speaker: Voting Results for the Emissary's Outfit
Voting Results for the Emissary's Outfit
dialogues.text: I hereby announce the result of the voting, which was calculated in a transparent and fair manner.

talks.objective: Check out the results of the vote

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, there's already a crowd gathering in front of the Bulletin Board. Let Paimon see! Coming through!

dialogues.speaker: Yuu
dialogues.text: Oh, I didn't expect the votes to differ by that much. I thought for sure that Masako would win, given that Warrior's Spirit is a competition unique to Inazuma!

dialogues.speaker: Tetsuya
dialogues.text: Just as I predicted. After all, "The Case Files of Miss Orith" is a recent bestseller. Not only is the story interesting, but the book's illustrations of Fontaine outfits are also really unique.

dialogues.speaker: Tetsuya
dialogues.text: Besides, don't you think that Miss Orith's character is a good fit for Miss Kamisato?

dialogues.speaker: Yuu
dialogues.text: Well... Miss Orith is fiercely competitive, but loves to play pranks on others, which is nearly the complete opposite of Miss Kamisato. However, it'll be interesting to see Miss Kamisato in a Fontaine outfit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, what're they talking about? Paimon's kinda confused.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, look! There are some options for the outfits... "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji"? "The Case Files of Miss Orith"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on, didn't they say the choices were gonna be between the four seasons of Inazuma? When did they switch to cosplay outfits from light novels?

choices.text: Maybe they had a change in plans?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks we need to find out what happened. C'mon, let's find Ayaka at the Yashiro Commission!

choices.text: Maybe something went wrong with the poll?

dialogues.speaker: Mizuta
dialogues.text: I'm terribly sorry, I was the one who mixed up the two voting boxes! By the time Mr. Onodera came back from his business trip, the results had already been announced...

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: *sigh* In an effort to keep things confidential, we specifically didn't mark the ballots with the title of the poll. I regret that decision now that everything's gotten mixed up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way... something did go wrong with the outfit voting.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, it seems you've also heard about the results.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, and we're not the only ones... It felt like everyone we saw on the way here was talking about it. What are you going to do?

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: Miss Kamisato, we're the ones responsible for this blunder. I'll go reorganize a vote right now and we'll set things straight.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Please wait, Onodera. There might be yet another solution.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The poll error is something that only the competition organizers are aware of. The public didn't seem to notice anything wrong with the ballots.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Moreover, there were no complaints when people thought that outfits from popular works would make an appearance in the exhibition match. On the contrary, everyone seemed to think it was a special surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Since our goal was to generate interest in the competition, the consequences of this mistake shouldn't be viewed a "blunder."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, Ayaka, so do you mean that—

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes, I think we should just make the best of this mistake. In the final exhibition match, I'll simply wear whichever outfit accumulated the most votes.

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: Yes, but... that will make things difficult for you, Miss Kamisato. Unlike outfits tailored for martial arts, the outfits from the novels aren't designed for combat.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It won't be a problem. The Fontaine-style dress from the novel shouldn't be too heavy, so it won't affect my abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I'll try to get used to it, even if it's quite different than something I'm accustomed to wearing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Ayaka is speaking calmly, but Paimon can still feel her courage!

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: Alright, I understand. In that case, we'll proceed with Miss Kamisato's proposal.

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: The outfit we prepared for the readers' meet and greet will be tailored and adjusted according to Miss Kamisato's figure. We'll ensure that the outfit is completely ready for the exhibition match!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Thank you. It's a lot to handle, but I'm sure you can manage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ayaka, will you really be okay wearing some character's cosplay in the exhibition match? You're not pushing yourself because we're here, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: No, please don't worry. I actually feel relaxed and even a little joyful at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Before, the thought of wearing a fancy dress on the stage of the exhibition match had me worried. I was concerned about whether I would be presentable enough to meet the audience's expectations.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: However, if I'm wearing the same clothes as a fictional character, then it shouldn't be too big of an issue. The detective in the novel is known for being mischievous and doing things her own way.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Everyone watching the exhibition match will be able to experience something new in a traditional form.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (So that's what Ayaka was thinking...)

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: And that's not all... Deep down, I've always been looking forward to the day I could wear something different from what I normally do.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, not long after we met, I remember you mentioning that Liyue, Mondstadt... and every nation has their own unique fashion.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: At that time, I couldn't imagine that one day I would be able to experience all these foreign places. But now, all those wishes that were once impossible don't seem so far out of reach.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Besides, my mother was always curious about outfits from other countries when she was alive. This time, I will be able to fulfill my mother's dream.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Thinking about it that way, this special outfit can indeed be called a surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, in that case, this whole accident with the vote turned out to be a good thing, hehe. Well, now that this is all settled, let's get ready to go to the arena.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes, I know you will do great, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Onodera and I will also head to the arena to watch your fight once we've confirmed my outfit's measurements.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Today's the third day of the competition. The voting results for Ayaka's outfit should be ready, right? Let's check the Bulletin Board in Inazuma City.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wonders which outfit theme won, hehe.
